name: Grenade
description: Grenades are Pickables which Characters can grab and throw. It explodes after X seconds after thrown, causing damage around.

parameters.name: static_mesh_asset
parameters.description: The Static Mesh asset to use

parameters.name: spawn_mode
parameters.description: Pass SpawnMode.AfterConstructor or SpawnMode.Manual to avoid immediately sending the entity to clients and improve performance when you want to configure it by setting several configs. Must call FinishSpawn() after all

functions.name: SetDamage
functions.description: Sets Damage parameters of this Grenade

parameters.name: damage_outer_radius
parameters.description: Radius which damage will be interpolated through falloff

parameters.name: damage_falloff
parameters.description: Lerp function between Max and Min damage

functions.name: SetTimeToExplode
functions.description: Set Time until Explosion after thrown

parameters.name: throw_force
parameters.description: The new Impulse applied when throwing

functions.name: GetBaseDamage
functions.description: Gets the max damage, applied within the inner radius

functions.name: GetDamageFalloff
functions.description: Gets the falloff exponent used to interpolate between the base and the minimum damage

functions.name: GetDamageInnerRadius
functions.description: Gets the radius within which the base damage is fully applied

functions.name: GetDamageOuterRadius
functions.description: Gets the radius at which the damage reaches the minimum damage

functions.name: GetMinimumDamage
functions.description: Gets the min damage, applied at the outer radius

functions.name: GetTimeToExplode
functions.description: Gets the time until the explosion after throwing

functions.name: GetThrowForce
functions.description: Gets the impulse applied when throwing

events.name: Explode
events.description: Triggered when the grenade has exploded

events.name: Throw
events.description: Triggered when the grenade has been thrown

arguments.name: handler
arguments.description: The Character which has thrown it
